P1.2.text: ITT is a diversified leading manufacturer of highly engineered critical components and customized technology solutions for the transportation, industrial, and energy markets.

P1.3.text: ITT's highly engineered critical components keep the world safe, moving and sustainable

P1.4.text: We're engineers and innovators who solve our customers' most critical challenges

P1.5.text: At ITT, we make a lasting difference in the world by powering key industries, advancing transportation safety and comfort, connecting people to data and each other, and securing essential infrastructure

P1.6.text: Our global brands keep the world moving

P1.7.text: With more than 175 years of history, ITT Goulds Pumps is among the most widely recognized and respected brands in the global pump industry, serving leading customers in the energy, chemical and general industrial markets

P1.8.text: We serve growing end markets including automotive, rail, chemical, industrial, aerospace and defense, among others

P1.10.text: Our solutions change the modern world

P2.2.text: We are a manufacturer of critical, engineered components that serve fast-growing end markets in transportation, flow, energy, aerospace and defense.

P2.3.text: We are committed every day to reflecting our core principles. These principles not only enhance our ability to achieve our purpose, they also define our high-performing culture and help us deliver on our ambitious growth strategy.

P2.4.text: Around the world, we have a clear vision of where key industries are headed and how we can help customers reach their goals by thinking our way around obstacles, creating solutions and finding answers to complex technical and engineering challenges. Our customers rely on our expertise to create better products to serve their customers and at the same time increase uptime and energy efficiency in their manufacturing operations.

P2.5.text: We produce our wide range of innovative products and solutions through three operating segments: Flow Technologies, Motion Technologies, and Connect and Control Technologies.

P2.6.text: We strive to make our work environment inclusive and welcoming. By encouraging a healthy, high-performing culture and by making our customers central to everything we do, we create an atmosphere that enhances innovation and the success of our talented employees. Together, our purpose and principles guide our words and actions every day and are truly touchstones that unite employees across ITT as we aim to develop solutions to complex challenges and make a positive and enduring impact.

P3.2.text: With over 90 years of aerospace technology development, Aerospace Controls is leading the way in design, engineering and manufacturing of top-of-the-line actuators, fluid control devices and environmental control systems for the aerospace and defense industries. We strive to continuously offer new, cutting-edge products that set us apart and make us a leader in the global aerospace technology markets.

P3.3.text: Anhydro® designs drying, evaporation and powder processing solutions for dairy, food, pharmaceutical and chemical manufacturers. The portfolio combines proven process technologies, engineering expertise and complete turnkey systems to help manufacturers improve product quality, optimize energy efficiency and maximize production performance. Supported by Innovation Center capabilities and comprehensive lifecycle support, Anhydro helps manufacturers develop, scale and optimize processes with confidence throughout the life of their plant.

P3.4.text: APV® develops process technologies and end-to-end processing solutions for dairy, food, beverage, pharmaceutical, personal care and industrial manufacturers. From heat exchangers and thermal processing to membrane filtration, homogenization, microparticulation and automation, APV helps manufacturers improve product quality, production efficiency and operational performance. Backed by more than a century of engineering innovation, Innovation Centers and comprehensive lifecycle support, APV helps manufacturers develop new products, optimize processes and maximize long-term value.
